section_summary.extract_value: This Conclusions section states that external shame affects body appreciation indirectly via self-compassion, suggesting self-compassion mediates that relationship. It recommends exploring self-compassion as a positive, health-promoting tool and targeting shame and self-compassion in prevention and community programs. The section contains no details about study samples, measures, country, number of studies (e.g., 'Study 1'), or statistical values.
section_summary.evidence_source: Quoted sentences from the Conclusions: 'The effect of external shame on body appreciation was found to be significant at an indirect level, i.e., carried by the mechanisms of self-compassion.' and 'Therefore, present findings seem to suggest that self-compassion may act as mediator of the aforementioned relationship...'.
